Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a chemical cross-linking (XL-MS) study using Sulfo-SMPB to map interactions between lamin fragments. While not a traditional TPP (Thermal Proteome Profiling) assay, XL-MS for structural mapping is often routed through similar structural proteomics modifiers (mod_tpp) or specialized XL-MS workflows in Stage 4. The search parameters explicitly define custom mass shifts for the cross-linker.
